name: Estantería — spatial shelf of four peer cards

axes.concept: Spatial: the four catalogue plans stand side by side on one shelf as conventional, equal subscription cards; because the catalogue is cumulative, every tool sits on the same shelf row in every card that includes it, so the growth from Entusiasta to Master Designer is read by position, not by comparison controls, highlights or selection.
axes.layout: Production /planes shell unchanged (ring-and-dot brand, Idioma select, H1 Planes + Volver al acceso, administrator sentence, footer; signed-in account bar above when there is a session). The removed tabs/side index/sheet are replaced by one shelf: 4 equal columns when the shelf is at least 1040px wide (1280 desktop), 2×2 from 600px (768 tablet), one column below (360/390 phone). In 4 and 2 columns each card spans 11 shared subgrid rows (name, price, tools heading, 8 tool rows), so names, prices and each tool line up across cards; in one column cards flow naturally with no empty rows.
axes.navigation: No in-page index, tabs or selection (all removed by P-211). Orientation is spatial: on phones each card's head (plan name + monthly price) is sticky while its tool list scrolls past it, so a reader never loses which plan a tool belongs to. Remaining navigation is the existing Volver al acceso link, the Idioma select (and, signed in, the account menu with its ES/EN pair and Planes entry marked aria-current). Legacy ?vista=seleccionar renders the identical shelf.
axes.typography: Production Geist Sans/Geist Mono only. H1 24px/600 (unchanged); plan name 18px/600; monthly amount 30px/650 tabular figures (26px phone) with a 13px muted currency/month unit; tools heading 12px/550 muted; tools 14px/1.45; unavailable marker 12px aviso; footer and mockup note 12px (mono only for the mockup note).
axes.density: Airy cards, compact lists: 16px gutters, 24px radius cards with 24/22px insets (20px phone), 18px head bottom padding under a rule, 6px tool-row padding. Shorter plans keep empty shelf rows at desktop/tablet so rows align; phone removes them.
axes.components: Semantic article cards (no buttons, no CTAs, not focusable) with header (h2 + price), h3 tools heading and ul of tools with lucide Check icons; real shadcn/Base UI Button for Reintentar and Skeleton for loading; Motion AnimatePresence for the price roll and the account popup; native select for Idioma; account bar/menu reused from the chosen cuentas-admin@v2.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures globals.css tokens in both themes: superficie cards on fondo, borde card edges, borde-suave head rule, acento only on available-tool checks, focus ring and the retry action; aviso for unavailable tools; error icon in the error state. No card is tinted, highlighted or badged.
axes.motion: Spatial glide grammar (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); 620ms expressive / 380ms natural / 180ms subtle): on load the cards are dealt from behind the first card to their own cells (WAAPI translate from card 1's box, 70ms stagger); tool rows slot in sideways (translateX -10px, 28ms per row); crossing a breakpoint, every card glides from its previous cell to its new one (manual FLIP); switching ES/EN rolls the old currency up out of the price slot and the new one in from below (spring 260/26). Repeated controls stay at 90–180ms. Reduced motion, Quieto and ?still=1 remove all travel; hidden tabs pause.
